findings.title: Juniper Networks Patches Critical Junos OS Vulnerabilities Across Core Platforms
findings.summary_md: Juniper Networks published its October 2026 security bulletins on October 14, 2026, resolving dozens of critical Junos OS vulnerabilities. Several flaws carry a 9.8 CVSS v3.1 score and allow unauthenticated remote code execution or full device takeover.

findings.title: Out-of-band Security Notification (October 14, 2026)
findings.summary_md: F5 announced out-of-band fixes on October 14, 2026 for NGINX defects including the critical unauthenticated RCE bugs CVE-2026-15176 and CVE-2026-93479. The advisory covers NGINX Plus and Open Source versions with buffer-overflow and memory-corruption risks under certain configurations.

findings.title: NGINX security advisories
findings.summary_md: NGINX lists CVE-2026-97205 as affecting async file I/O configurations, with vulnerable versions 0.8.11 through 1.31.6 and fixed releases 1.31.7+ and 1.30.6+. The advisory page was updated as part of the October 14, 2026 coordinated disclosure.
